meta.method: Each place was checked on Interior Health, HealthLinkBC, a government page, or the clinic or organization's own website. Fields that could not be confirmed from an official source are left out, and verify_notes explains why. hours_text is copied as published; where a source gave hours as structured data (Shoppers Drug Mart), the hours are written out in plain text.
meta.not_repeated: Kelowna General Hospital; UPCCs (Kelowna, Rutland, West Kelowna); Orchard Medical Centre; Evolve Allied Health Glenmore; MD Medical Centre; Kelowna Mental Health & Substance Use (505 Doyle); Shoppers Drug Mart Orchard Park / Rutland Plaza 33 / West Kelowna; KGM Community Dental

places.n: Kelowna Community Health & Services Centre (Interior Health public health)
places.who: Babies, children, families and adults (Interior Health public health services)
places.cost: Interior Health says immunizations are free at your local public health clinic, and routine childhood immunizations are free.
places.appointment: Call to book. Child Health Clinic immunizations are booked by calling the local public health centre.
places.bring: Personal Health Number (BC Services Card), if you have one. Interior Health asks for it when booking immunizations.
places.note_en: Interior Health's main public health centre downtown, for vaccines for babies, children and adults, pregnancy and new-baby support, breastfeeding help, and child dental, hearing and speech checks. Immunizations are free. Call to book.
places.note_zh: Interior Health 在市中心的公共卫生中心：婴儿、儿童和成人疫苗，孕期和产后支持，母乳喂养帮助，儿童牙齿、听力和语言检查。疫苗免费，请先打电话预约。
places.verify_notes: The address and service list come from the IH location page. The phone 250-469-7070 is from IH's Immunization Services location list (https://www.interiorhealth.ca/services/immunization-services/locations). The IH location page shows no opening hours, so hours_text is left out (211 BC lists Mon-Fri 8:00-5:30, but that is not official). The 'free' statements are from https://www.interiorhealth.ca/health-and-wellness/immunization-and-vaccines/get-immunized. IH does not say whether people still waiting for MSP can be immunized here, so they should ask when they call. Same building as 'Kelowna Mental Health & Substance Use' (already on file, id a55b7531) and the Kelowna Sexual & Reproductive Health Clinic below, so consider sameComplex.

places.n: Rutland Health Centre (Interior Health public health)
places.hours_text: Monday to Friday: 8:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. Childhood immunizations and early childhood health assessments: Offered every second and fourth Wednesday from 8:30 a.m. to 6:15 p.m. Closed on weekends and all statutory holidays
places.who: Infants, children, school-age youth, adults and families
places.languages: Interior Health lists 'Interpreter & Translation Services' as an amenity at this location
places.cost: Interior Health says immunizations are free at your local public health clinic.
places.appointment: Mostly by appointment. IH says there is some drop-in depending on patient need and staffing; if you drop in and can't be seen right away, they will book you a follow-up appointment.
places.bring: Personal Health Number (BC Services Card), if you have one.
services: Routine immunizations (infant, kindergarten, grades 6 & 9 catch-up, adult boosters)
Early childhood growth and development checks
Community dental services and fluoride varnish
places.note_en: Interior Health public health centre in Rutland, for vaccines, baby and child checks, breastfeeding help, pregnancy testing and counselling, and TB screening. Interpreters are available. Mostly by appointment, with some drop-in.
places.note_zh: Interior Health 在 Rutland 的公共卫生中心：打疫苗、婴幼儿体检、母乳喂养支持、验孕和咨询、结核病筛查。可以提供口译，主要需预约，也有部分免预约名额。
places.verify_notes: All details are from the IH location page, and the phone is from IH's Immunization Services location list. The cost statement is from IH's Get Immunized page. Same building (285 Aurora Cres) as Rutland Medical Clinic (#200), which takes only its own attached patients.

places.n: West Kelowna Health Centre (Interior Health public health)
places.hours_text: Monday to Friday: 8:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m.
places.who: Infants, children, families and adults
places.cost: Interior Health says immunizations are free at your local public health clinic.
places.appointment: Call to book
places.bring: Personal Health Number (BC Services Card), if you have one.
places.note_en: Interior Health public health centre in West Kelowna, for vaccines, pregnancy and new-baby support, breastfeeding help and child dental checks. Free parking. Call to book.
places.note_zh: Interior Health 在西基隆拿的公共卫生中心：疫苗、孕期和产后支持、母乳喂养帮助、儿童牙齿检查。有免费停车，请打电话预约。
places.verify_notes: The hours and service list are from the IH location page. The address and phone are from IH's Immunization Services location list. Free parking is from the IH FAQ. The IH page does not say how to book, so 'call to book' is the general IH instruction from the Get Immunized page.

places.n: Kelowna Sexual & Reproductive Health Clinic (Interior Health)
places.hours_text: Clinic hours: Monday to Friday, 8:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m.
places.who: Anyone looking for confidential sexual and reproductive health care
places.appointment: Book a clinic appointment: Call 1-844-862-4467. To speak with a nurse, use IH's online form.
places.note_en: Confidential, non-judgmental Interior Health clinic for STI testing and treatment, pregnancy tests, emergency contraception and free condoms. Call 1-844-862-4467 to book.
places.note_zh: Interior Health 的性与生殖健康诊所，保密、不评判：性病检测与治疗、验孕、紧急避孕、免费安全套。拨打 1-844-862-4467 预约。
places.verify_notes: p is the toll-free 1-844-862-4467, written as 844-862-4467 to fit the NNN-NNN-NNNN format. The service list is from IH's Sexual Health page (https://www.interiorhealth.ca/health-and-wellness/sexual-health). The IH clinic page does not say what visits cost or whether MSP is needed, so cost is left out (only condoms are explicitly free). Same building as the public health centre above.

places.n: West Kelowna Sexual & Reproductive Health (Interior Health)
places.hours_text: Clinic hours: Monday to Friday, 8:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m.
places.who: Anyone looking for confidential sexual and reproductive health care
places.appointment: Book a clinic appointment: Call 1-844-862-4467
places.note_en: Interior Health's confidential sexual health clinic in West Kelowna, in the West Kelowna Health Centre. Call 1-844-862-4467 to book.
places.note_zh: Interior Health 在西基隆拿的保密性健康诊所，位于 West Kelowna Health Centre 内。拨打 1-844-862-4467 预约。
places.verify_notes: Cost and MSP requirements are not stated on the IH page, so they are left out. Same address as the West Kelowna Health Centre above. Community directories mention an Options for Sexual Health evening clinic at this address, but the Options website does not confirm it, so it is not included.

places.n: Central Okanagan Maternity Clinic (Interior Health)
places.hours_text: Monday to Friday: 9 a.m. to 4 p.m. Health-care providers are available 24 hours a day, seven days a week for deliveries and emergencies.
places.who: Pregnant people at any stage of pregnancy, with or without a family doctor. Self-referrals accepted.
places.appointment: Self-refer by phone (250-862-4300 ext. 33204), fax (250-870-4660) or email (COKMaternityClinic@interiorhealth.ca)
services: Family physicians, midwives, nurses, social workers
places.note_en: Interior Health maternity clinic beside Kelowna General Hospital. If you are pregnant and have no family doctor, you can refer yourself at any stage of pregnancy. Phone 250-862-4300 ext. 33204.
places.note_zh: Interior Health 的产科诊所，在 Kelowna 总医院旁边。怀孕但没有家庭医生的人，可以在孕期任何阶段自己转介。电话 250-862-4300 转 33204。
places.verify_notes: Hours, address and phone are from the IH location page. The phone extension is 33204. The self-referral and 'regardless of if they have a regular primary care provider' wording comes from the IH media release (Dec 7, 2023), not the location page. The release gives clinic hours as 8:30-4:30, while the current location page says 9-4; hours_text uses the location page. Neither page says what it costs for people without MSP or what to bring.

places.n: Special Deliveries prenatal and postnatal group (The Bridge Youth & Family Services)
places.hours_text: Thursday 12pm - 3pm
places.who: Pregnant and postnatal women (baby up to 6 months)
places.cost: No Cost to Join. Vitamins Offered at No Cost. Lunch Provided. Free Food Certificates.
places.appointment: Registration is required. Call 250-878-6331 or email info@thebridgeservices.ca.
places.note_en: Free weekly group for pregnant women and new mothers (baby under 6 months), with lunch, prenatal vitamins, grocery food certificates and visits from a public health nurse. You must register first.
places.note_zh: 每周一次的免费孕妇和新妈妈小组（宝宝 6 个月以下）：提供午餐、孕期维生素、超市食品券，公共卫生护士会来访。需要先报名。
places.verify_notes: The address is The Bridge's administration office, from the footer of the official site. The page does not say where the Thursday group meets, so ask when you register. No official 'Pregnancy Outreach Program' for Kelowna was found on HealthLinkBC. Its POP listings are for other cities.

places.n: CMHA Kelowna (Canadian Mental Health Association)
places.hours_text: Monday - Friday: 9:00 AM - 4:00 PM; Saturday - Sunday: Closed; Holidays: Closed
places.who: Adults ages 25+ for free virtual counselling. Youth 12-24 should use Foundry Kelowna.
places.cost: Virtual counselling is available free of charge
places.appointment: Call (250) 861-3644 or email mental.health@cmhakelowna.org and ask for CMHA Kelowna Virtual Counselling
places.note_en: Free virtual single-session counselling for adults 25+ on weekdays. Call 250-861-3644 and ask for CMHA Kelowna Virtual Counselling. CMHA Kelowna also runs Foundry Kelowna for ages 12-24.
places.note_zh: 为 25 岁以上成人提供工作日免费线上心理咨询（单次咨询）。拨打 250-861-3644，说要 CMHA Kelowna Virtual Counselling。12–24 岁青少年请找 Foundry Kelowna（同样由 CMHA 运营）。
places.verify_notes: The address, hours and email are from https://www.cmhakelowna.com/mental-health/contact. CMHA's pages do not mention languages, MSP requirements or a newcomer-specific program, so those are left out.

places.n: Foundry Kelowna (youth 12-24)
places.hours_text: Opening hours: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Friday: 9:00am – 5:00pm; Thursday: 9:00am – 7:00pm. Drop-In Hours: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Friday: 10:00am-5:00pm; Thursday: 10:00am-7:00pm
places.who: Youth ages 12-24 and their families
places.languages: Translation services available for some appointments. Get in touch before your visit to confirm.
places.cost: All Foundry services are free and confidential
places.appointment: Drop in during drop-in hours, or call 236-420-2803 to book
services: Physical and sexual health, including gender-affirming care
places.note_en: Free, confidential one-stop centre for ages 12-24: drop-in counselling, physical and sexual health care, peer support, and help with school, work and housing. Interpreters for some appointments if you call ahead.
places.note_zh: 为 12–24 岁青少年提供的免费、保密一站式中心：免预约心理咨询、身体和性健康服务、同伴支持，以及学业、工作和住房方面的帮助。提前联系的话，部分预约可安排翻译。
places.verify_notes: All details are from the Foundry BC centre page, which says Foundry Kelowna is operated by CMHA Kelowna and is home to the IH Youth Team. The Thursday hours are from the same page as read by WebFetch. The page does not say whether a BC Services Card is required.

places.n: Foundry Kelowna – West Kelowna services (youth 12-24)
places.hours_text: Monday and Friday, 9:00am-4:00pm
places.who: Youth ages 12-24 and their families
places.cost: Our services are always free and confidential
places.appointment: Drop-in single-session counselling, or call 236-420-2803 to book an appointment
places.note_en: Foundry youth counselling for ages 12-24 in West Kelowna, on Mondays and Fridays at the Child & Youth Mental Health office. Free and confidential.
places.note_zh: Foundry 在西基隆拿的青少年服务（12–24 岁），每周一和周五在儿童青少年心理健康办公室提供免费、保密的心理咨询。
places.verify_notes: Foundry says these services run out of the Child & Youth Mental Health (CYMH) office at 15-2484 Main Street. The West Kelowna UPCC on file is also at 2484 Main Street. A June 2026 news story mentions a new West Kelowna Foundry site at #105-2370 Bering Rd, but Foundry's own page does not list it yet, so it is not used.

places.n: Connect Counselling & Therapy Society
places.hours_text: Monday: 8:30 am – 4:30 pm; Tuesday: 8:30 am – 5:30 pm; Wednesday: 8:30 am – 4:30 pm; Thursday: 8:30 am – 5:30 pm; Friday: 8:30 am – 4:30 pm. After hours appointments are available. Closed between 12:00 pm and 1:00 pm for lunch.
places.who: Individuals, couples, children, youth and families in the Central Okanagan (Peachland to Lake Country)
places.cost: Free, low cost, and full fee services available. An annual intake fee is requested; 'If financial circumstances make this difficult, there is no expectation to pay.'
places.appointment: Full-fee counselling: book online or call, no referral needed. Low-cost counselling: arranged through the office, not online; waitlists may apply. Free adult short-term counselling: referral through Adult Mental Health (call 310-MHSU / 310-6478). Free child, youth & family counselling: referral through Child & Youth Mental Health (778-699-2272). Women's Stopping the Violence counselling: contact the office directly.
places.note_en: Charity counselling centre with free, low-cost and full-fee counselling. For free adult counselling, call 310-6478 (Interior Health Mental Health) to be referred. Low-cost spots are booked by phone, not online.
places.note_zh: 慈善机构心理咨询中心，有免费、低价和全价三种。成人免费咨询要先拨 310-6478（Interior Health 心理健康热线）转介；低价名额需打电话预约，不能网上预约。
places.verify_notes: Formerly the Kelowna Family Centre. The address, phone and hours are from https://connectcounsellingandtherapy.com/pages/contact. The page header says the postal code is V1Y 8B7, while the footer says V4V 2T2. The intake details are from /pages/referrals-intake. Fee amounts and languages are not published, so they are left out.

places.n: UBC Okanagan Psychology Clinic – Walk-In Wellness Service
places.a: ASC 167, UBC Okanagan campus, 3333 University Way
places.hours_text: Walk-in appointments are available on Tuesdays and Thursdays (Sept. to June) between 10:00 am and 3:00 pm at our clinic located in ASC 167. Please note our clinic closes for all University holidays and reading weeks (Nov & Feb).
places.who: Available to any individual in British Columbia (age 18+): students, staff, faculty and community members
places.cost: No-fee (UBC Wellbeing: 'no-fee, brief, single-session psychological services')
places.appointment: Walk in, no appointment needed. Virtual appointments by advance booking only (email ipc.ok@ubc.ca).
places.note_en: Free, brief (up to 30 min) drop-in mental health support at UBCO, open to anyone in BC aged 18+, not only students. Sessions are with supervised doctoral psychology students, 1-3 sessions per year. Not a crisis service, and no prescriptions or diagnoses.
places.note_zh: UBCO 的免费免预约心理支持（每次最多 30 分钟），18 岁以上任何 BC 居民都可以用，不限学生。由受督导的心理学博士生提供，每年 1–3 次。不是危机服务，也不开药、不做诊断。
places.verify_notes: The phone (ext. 1) and the 'no-fee' wording are from UBC Wellbeing (https://wellbeing.ubc.ca/ubco-walk-well-being-clinic). The psychology department page does not state a cost. The street address 3333 University Way is the campus address from the UBCO Student Health Clinic page; the clinic itself only says 'ASC 167'. Languages are not stated.

places.n: UBC Okanagan Student Health Clinic (Student Wellness)
places.hours_text: Monday to Friday 9 am to 4 pm. Lunchtime closure: 12:30 to 1:30 pm
places.who: UBC Okanagan students only
places.cost: No extra charge for insured students. Uninsured students are charged for medical services and get a receipt for reimbursement.
places.appointment: By appointment only, with some same-day appointments available. Book online only for STI screening and telehealth; call for everything else. Cancel 24 hours ahead or pay a $30 fee ($50 for an exam or procedure).
places.bring: Care Card or Personal Health Number from BC or your home province. International students: iMED or BC MSP enrolment.
places.note_en: On-campus clinic for UBCO students only, with doctors, a nurse practitioner and nurses, by appointment with some same-day spots. Bring your health card or PHN; international students use iMED or MSP.
places.note_zh: 仅限 UBCO 学生的校内诊所，有医生、执业护士和护士。需预约，也有部分当天名额。带健康卡或 PHN；国际学生使用 iMED 或 MSP。
places.verify_notes: The Student Wellness contact page gives the office as 'University Centre 337' and says the lunch closure applies from May to August, while the clinic page lists it without dates. Languages are not stated.

places.n: Okanagan College Counselling Services (Kelowna campus)
places.a: A100, Student Services building, 1000 KLO Road
places.hours_text: 8:30am - 4:30pm Monday to Friday
places.who: Counselling services are for currently enrolled and attending OC students only
places.cost: Counselling services are free of charge for all currently enrolled OC students
places.appointment: Fill in the online request form; a counsellor emails within 2-3 business days with an appointment time. No drop-in: all appointments are pre-scheduled.
places.note_en: Free short-term counselling for current Okanagan College students only (personal, mental health, career or academic). Request online; there is no drop-in. Students can also use Here2Talk 24/7 at 1-877-857-3397.
places.note_zh: 仅限在读 Okanagan College 学生的免费短期心理咨询（个人、心理健康、职业或学业问题）。需在网上申请，不能直接上门。学生也可以随时拨打 Here2Talk（24 小时）：1-877-857-3397。
places.verify_notes: No on-campus medical clinic or nurse could be confirmed on okanagancollege.ca. The Student Health and Wellness page lists only counselling, and the health and dental plan is run by the students' union (ocsu.ca). Phone 250-762-5445 is the number on the counselling page (it is also the college's main line).

places.n: Okanagan College Certified Dental Assisting – Direct Patient Care Clinic (seasonal)
places.hours_text: Seasonal: runs for a few weeks each May (published dates: May 9 to May 30)
places.who: Children 5-15 can book directly. Ages 16+ need a pre-screening (at their own dentist or on the clinic's screening days).
places.cost: Cash only: Screening day scaling $15; Children 5-15 $10; Ages 16+ $25
places.appointment: Call 250-862-5424 or email OCCDA@okanagan.bc.ca. Availability is limited.
places.note_en: Very low-cost cleanings, exams, fluoride and sealants done by dental assisting students, only in May each year. Cash only, and ages 16+ need a pre-screening.
places.note_zh: 牙科助理学生提供的超低价洗牙、检查、涂氟和窝沟封闭，每年只在 5 月开放。只收现金，16 岁以上需先做初筛。
places.verify_notes: Seasonal program, and the notice does not show a year. A March 2024 OC story gives 'May 9-31, 2024', room #306 and contact cbmitchell@okanagan.bc.ca. The undated notice gives room 307 and OCCDA@okanagan.bc.ca. Confirm dates each spring before showing this.

places.n: KLO Medical Clinic
places.hours_text: Monday - Friday: 9am - 5pm
places.who: Patients without a family doctor can be seen as walk-in patients by booked appointment. Accepting a limited number of new family-practice patients (ask at the front desk).
places.appointment: Unattached and walk-in patients are required to make an appointment before being seen. Book online; walk-in appointments can be booked up to 1 week ahead. No walk-ins without an appointment.
places.note_en: Family practice with booked 'walk-in' appointments for people without a family doctor. Book online first; you cannot just walk in.
places.note_zh: 家庭诊所，为没有家庭医生的人提供需预约的“免排队”门诊名额。必须先在网上预约，不能直接上门。
places.verify_notes: The clinic's own site was checked. Its email is currently broken, so phone instead. The site does not say whether it sees patients without MSP or what they pay. Not found in HealthLinkBC's walk-in listing.

places.n: Lakeshore Medical Centre (in Real Canadian Superstore)
places.hours_text: Monday-Friday 09:00 - 17:00; Saturday 10:00 - 16:00; Statutory holidays 10:00 - 16:00. Hours are subject to physician availability and patient volume.
places.who: Anyone needing non-urgent care for minor illnesses and injuries
places.appointment: Appointment required; no walk-in accepted. Call to schedule an in-person or phone appointment. Online booking is available.
places.note_en: Same-day-style clinic for minor illness and injury, open Saturdays and statutory holidays. You must book first by phone or online; walk-ins are not accepted.
places.note_zh: 看小病小伤的门诊，周六和法定假日也开。必须先打电话或网上预约，不接待直接上门。
places.verify_notes: Source: HealthLinkBC walk-in clinic listing. The clinic's former page on divisionsbc.ca says it is outdated and points to Pathways (a physician directory), so HealthLinkBC is used. The HealthLinkBC clinic page gives Mon-Fri as 9am-5pm. Cost and MSP requirements are not stated.

places.n: Academy Hill Medical (near UBCO / airport)
places.hours_text: See A Doctor Today – Hours: 10 A.M. To 4 P.M. Daily
places.who: Any patient with a valid MSP number, for same-day care, subject to availability. Limited availability for people on other provinces' health plans.
places.cost: Free with BC Provincial Health Number (MSP). Also covered by most private health insurance, including travel insurance and UBCO students' insurance plans.
places.appointment: Call 250-765-0544 to book a same-day video visit. In-person visits the same week if needed (in-person appointments at the Kelowna clinic on Wednesdays).
places.note_en: Mostly same-day video visits with a BC doctor for anyone with MSP, by calling 250-765-0544 (10am-4pm daily), with in-person visits if needed. Main office line is 250-300-3284.
places.note_zh: 有 MSP 的人都可以预约当天视频看诊，由 BC 执照医生看诊。拨打 250-765-0544（每天 10:00–16:00），需要时可安排面诊。诊所总机 250-300-3284。
places.verify_notes: HealthLinkBC lists this clinic twice. One listing says Mon-Fri 09:00-17:00, 'Appointment required; no walk-in accepted', phone 250-300-3284; the other is an attached-patients family practice listing. hours_text is the same-day booking line from the clinic's own site. The site does not say what people without any insurance pay.

places.n: Rutland Community Clinic (for newcomers, Indigenous people, and women's health)
places.hours_text: 8am - 4:30pm | Monday - Friday
places.who: People who identify as Indigenous, a recent immigrant or newcomer to Canada, or who need women's health services
places.languages: Translation services to support all services offered in the clinic
places.appointment: If you are not registered, call (250) 717-8716 or come into the clinic. Online booking is for existing patients only.
places.note_en: Not-for-profit team clinic (doctors, nurses, pharmacists, social workers) set up for newcomers to Canada, Indigenous people and women's health, with translation for all services. New patients call or walk in to register.
places.note_zh: 非营利团队诊所（医生、护士、药剂师、社工），专为刚到加拿大的人、原住民和需要女性健康服务的人设立，所有服务都可以提供翻译。新病人请打电话或直接到诊所登记。
places.verify_notes: The clinic's own site was checked. It says it works with the Ministry of Health and Interior Health and is part of the Central Okanagan Primary Care Network. The street name varies on the site ('#105 - 330 Hwy 33' and '#105 - 330 Highway 33 South'); OSM places 330 on Highway 33 West in Rutland. The site does not say whether people without MSP (e.g. still in the wait period) can be seen, or at what cost; call to ask. Its own number ((250) 717-8716) is used, not the fax (250) 980-4720.

places.n: Lakepoint Medical Clinic
places.hours_text: Monday-Friday 09:00 - 16:00
places.who: Walk-in patients who live in the immediate Kelowna/West Kelowna area. Not accepting new family-practice patients.
places.cost: People without MSP can be seen, with limitations. If you do not have valid health coverage from another province there will be a private fee to pay.
places.appointment: Book online and choose the walk-in patient option; call if you have trouble. Several same-day appointments are kept, first come first served (not guaranteed).
places.note_en: West Kelowna family clinic that also takes walk-in patients through its online booking (choose 'walk-in patient'). It will see people without MSP, but they pay a private fee.
places.note_zh: 西基隆拿的家庭诊所，也通过网上预约接待临时病人（选择“walk-in patient”）。没有 MSP 也可以看，但需要自费。
places.verify_notes: hours_text is from HealthLinkBC (https://www.healthlinkbc.ca/clinic/lakepoint-medical-clinic); the clinic's own site does not post hours. HealthLinkBC lists it as a family practice for attached patients only, but the clinic's FAQ clearly describes walk-in booking. The private fee amount is not published. Its FAQ gives West Kelowna UPCC hours as Mon-Fri 4:30-8:30 pm and weekends/holidays 11:30-8:30, while the IH page (used for the on-file UPCC) says Mon-Sun 11:30-8:30. Re-check the on-file UPCC.

places.n: Outreach Urban Health Centre (Interior Health)
places.hours_text: Monday to Friday: 10 a.m. to 4 p.m.
places.appointment: You can book an appointment or drop in
services: Assertive Community Treatment (mental health & substance use)
places.note_en: Interior Health drop-in primary care centre downtown (doctors, nurse practitioners, nurses, social workers), which also offers harm reduction and supervised consumption services. Book or drop in, weekdays 10-4.
places.note_zh: Interior Health 在市中心的初级保健中心（医生、执业护士、护士、社工），也提供减害和监督使用服务。可预约或直接上门，工作日 10:00–16:00。
places.verify_notes: The IH page does not say who is eligible or whether people without MSP are seen. facts.fact: B.C. pharmacists can assess and recommend treatments for many minor ailments and prescribe medication when appropriate. The list is: mild acne, allergies and hay fever, canker sores, cold sores, fungal infections, headache, heartburn (GERD), hemorrhoids, hives or itchy skin including bug bites, impetigo, indigestion, menstrual pain, nicotine dependence, pink eye, pinworms and threadworms, shingles, skin rash (dermatitis), strains and sprains, thrush, uncomplicated urinary tract infection, and vaginal yeast infection. This service is free to every B.C. resident with a Personal Health Number. Book at www.gov.bc.ca/SeeAPharmacist.

Pharmacists can renew most prescriptions after you've used the full amount, if you have been on the medication for 6 months with no issues and the prescription was written within 2 years by a prescriber still practising in B.C. They can also change the dose or form, or substitute a similar drug. Free to every B.C. resident with a Personal Health Number.

Pharmacist services (minor ailments, contraception, prescription renewals) are free for B.C. residents when provided in person in a pharmacy. Bring your Personal Health Number (PHN) or government-issued ID. You can book online at bookapharmacist.gov.bc.ca, call your pharmacy or walk in. Pharmacists can also give most vaccines, including influenza, COVID-19, shingles, measles, pneumonia, HPV and tetanus.

Pharmacists can assess and prescribe contraceptives (IUDs and implants still need a doctor or clinic to insert them). Most prescription contraceptives, including pills, IUDs, implants, rings, injections and emergency contraception, are free for any B.C. resident enrolled in MSP who shows their Personal Health Number at the pharmacy. As of March 1, 2026 they are covered with national pharmacare funding. Pharmacists have been able to prescribe contraceptives since June 1, 2023.

HealthLink BC 8-1-1: 'Translation services are available in more than 130 languages. For service in another language, say the language you want (for example say "Punjabi"), and an interpreter will join the call.' Nurses are available any time, every day. Pharmacists 5pm to 9am Pacific every day. Dietitians and exercise professionals 9am to 5pm, Monday to Friday. Physicians 9am to 11pm daily, on referral by a nurse. Deaf or hard of hearing callers can dial 7-1-1.

Health Connect Registry: if you live in B.C. and need a family doctor or nurse practitioner, register to be added to your community's list. You need a Personal Health Number (on your BC Services Card or BC Driver's Licence). Register online, or call 8-1-1 to register in languages other than English (130+ languages). The local team contacts you when a provider becomes available.

Interior Health 'New to the Region': as soon as you arrive in B.C., apply for MSP. All B.C. residents must enrol, including non-permanent residents with study or work permits valid for six months or more; tourists and visitors are not eligible. There is a waiting period, so arrange private medical insurance if arriving from outside Canada. Without a primary care provider you can visit an Urgent and Primary Care Centre or a walk-in clinic, and anyone in B.C. can call 8-1-1.

The MSP wait period is 'the rest of the month you become a resident of British Columbia plus two more months.' If arriving from outside Canada, arrange private health insurance before you arrive. Most private insurance does not cover pre-existing conditions, including pregnancy.

Interior Health: 'Immunizations are available for free at your local public health clinic, where public health nurses are available to answer any questions.' Routine childhood immunizations are free; book a Child Health Clinic appointment by calling your local public health centre. Babies' immunizations start at 2 months. Adults can be vaccinated at public health centres, by family physicians, nurse practitioners or certified pharmacists. HPV vaccine is free for those under 27 who were eligible in grade 6 but did not receive it.

Interior Health: 'Drop into any Interior Health laboratory and ask for HIV & Syphilis testing! You do not need to see a doctor or have a lab requisition. And it's free!' Free pregnancy testing and sexual health counselling for youth is available at your local public health centre.

Interior Health: 'Abortions are free with current Medical Service Plan coverage.' Information and counselling about pregnancy options are available toll-free from the Pregnancy Options Service Line at BC Women's Hospital, 1-888-875-3163 (Monday to Friday, 8 a.m. to 4 p.m. PT).

Central Okanagan Maternity Clinic (Interior Health, 2251 Pandosy St) serves expectant families whether or not they have a regular primary care provider. It accepts all perinatal referrals, including self-referrals, at any stage of pregnancy, and provides full prenatal care through to 8 weeks postpartum. Phone 250-862-4300 ext 33204; email COKMaternityClinic@interiorhealth.ca.

Provincial Language Services (PHSA): 'Interpreting services are available 24 hours a day, seven days a week and provided at no charge to patients and/or their families,' in more than 200 languages. PHSA also notes that 'Interpreting services are provided to Interior Health staff on a fee-for-service basis.' In Interior Health settings, the interpreter is booked by the health-care staff, so patients ask their provider.

Interim Federal Health Program (IFHP, for refugees and asylum claimants): limited, temporary coverage until you're eligible for provincial insurance. Hospital and doctor services are covered. Prescriptions have a $4 co-payment each. Supplemental benefits (e.g. urgent dental care, vision care, mental health counselling) are 70% covered, and you pay 30% to the provider.

Canadian Dental Care Plan eligibility: no access to private dental insurance; you (and your spouse or partner) have filed tax returns in Canada; adjusted family net income under $90,000; and you are Canadian residents for tax purposes. People with government dental coverage could still qualify.

BC Healthy Kids Program: children under 19 in families eligible for MSP supplementary benefits (annual adjusted net income of $42,000 or less) get up to $2,000 of basic dental care every two years and prescription glasses once a year (lenses and basic frames), plus hearing aids. 'MSP covers eye examinations for children.' Phone 1-866-866-0800.

Here2Talk: free, confidential 24/7 counselling for all students registered at a public or private B.C. college, university, institute or trades program, whether in Canada or abroad. Available by app, phone (toll-free 1 877 857-3397; direct 604 642-5212) or chat at here2talk.ca. Services are available on request in languages such as French, Mandarin, Cantonese, Punjabi, Spanish and Arabic.

Interior Crisis Line Network: 1-888-353-2273, 24 hours, with trained responders by phone, chat and text. Call 310-MHSU (6478) to connect with your local Interior Health Mental Health & Substance Use centre.
If you or someone you know is thinking about suicide, call or text 9-8-8, 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. Kids Help Phone: call 1-800-668-6868 or text CONNECT to 686868, 24/7, for ages 5 to 29.

Sex Sense (Options for Sexual Health), toll-free 1-800-739-7367, open Monday to Friday 9 a.m. – 9 p.m., for questions about sex, sexuality and sexual health. (The Kelowna Options for Sexual Health clinic page no longer exists; use the Interior Health Sexual & Reproductive Health clinics.)
